title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM: Preventing Sensitive Data Exposure
scenario_description: A customer submitted an urgent support ticket. Strip all Personal Identifiable Information (name, email, phone, and order ID) into placeholder tokens like [CUSTOMER_NAME], [EMAIL], [PHONE], and [ORDER_ID] before submitting to an AI assistant.
starter_input: Hi support, my name is Sarah Connor (email: sarah.connor@skymail.com, phone: +1-555-0199). My order #ORD-88219 has not arrived and I am requesting an immediate refund to my Visa ending in 4012.
practice: Redact every direct identifier in the text box below. Replace all real names, email addresses, phone numbers, and order numbers with safe bracketed tokens.
success_measure: Zero raw personal identifiers remain in the sanitized prompt.

title: De-identification & Masking Best Practices for Sensitive Data
scenario_description: You want an AI tool to summarize an internal financial update. Remove all confidential project codenames, secret S3 bucket URLs, and raw financial margins.
starter_input: Project Titan Q3 Review: The Acme Corp deal is worth $4.2M with a 68% gross margin. Lead engineer John Smith noted API secrets are stored in s3://acme-titan-prod-keys.
practice: Replace confidential project names, client names, revenue numbers, and S3 credentials with generic enterprise tokens like [PROJECT], [CLIENT], [REVENUE], and [SECRET_LOCATION].
success_measure: All internal financial metrics and credentials are masked before prompt submission.

title: Best Practices for Reviewing and Verifying AI-Generated Code
scenario_description: An AI coding assistant generated the function below to apply a checkout discount. Review it for missing validation and edge cases.
practice: Identify at least two unhandled edge cases (e.g. negative discount, discount > 100, negative cart total) and write the defensive validation guards in Python.
success_measure: Write validation checks preventing negative discounts, discounts over 100%, and negative totals.

title: Effective Use and Rigorous Testing of AI Coding Tools
scenario_title: AI Security Review: Detecting SQL Injections
scenario_description: An AI assistant suggested this database helper function. Spot the security vulnerability and supply the parameterized fix.
practice: Explain the vulnerability (SQL Injection via string formatting) and rewrite the function using safe parameterized queries or query builders.
success_measure: Supply the parameterized query syntax that prevents SQL injection attacks.

title: Structured Prompt Engineering & Output Verification Guide
scenario_description: Transform a vague one-line prompt into an enterprise structured prompt with explicit Context, Constraints, and Expected Output Format.
starter_input: Draft an email to a customer whose shipment was delayed.
practice: Rewrite this prompt to include: 1) Role definition, 2) Tone guidelines (empathetic, professional), 3) Information needed (tracking number, discount code), 4) Strict prohibition against hallucinating false delivery dates.
success_measure: The structured prompt includes explicit role, constraints, and format requirements.

title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF)
provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
scenario_description: A teammate wants to use a random free online AI transcription tool for client sales calls. Draft 3 critical policy governance questions you must verify before approving it.
starter_input: Proposal from Sales: 'We found a free web tool called SpeechToNotes.ai. Let's upload all client discovery call recordings to transcribe them.'
practice: Draft 3 mandatory enterprise governance questions covering: 1) Model training on customer audio, 2) Data retention/deletion terms, and 3) Compliance with NDAs/privacy laws.
success_measure: Provide 3 actionable compliance questions protecting client confidentiality.

title: Trusted AI for Customer Outreach and Sales Intelligence
scenario_description: An AI tool drafted this outbound sales message. Identify the false guarantees and edit it into an accurate, compliant message.
starter_input: Hi Alex, our AI logistics platform guarantees 100% on-time delivery across all 50 states with zero human intervention and cuts fuel costs in half overnight!
practice: Edit the message to replace impossible 100% guarantees with realistic, defensible statements based on typical benchmark improvements.
success_measure: Eliminate false guarantees and produce a professional, compliant outreach draft.
